summary: John's maternal 3rd great-grandfather; contadino of Guardia Lombardi, father of John Petriello.
bio: Tree: Pietro Petrillo/Petriello + Grazia Di Marino (b. 1837). Son's 1869 birth act: Pietro Petriello fu Angelo, 33, contadino (so born c.1836). Death act: died 29 Mar 1901, Guardia (Via Piazza), aged 64 (so born c.1837), contadino, born in Guardia; son of the late Angelo and the late Lucia Marra; 'marito di Di Marino Grazia'; Morti 1901 act 28; the declarant was Francesco De Biasi, 72 (showing the families were close). Round 2 had this as probable from the FS tree (sourced to Avellino civil registers, FS records 6PG6-674L and 6PG6-674V). The FS tree also gives him an impossible wife 'Grazia Sasso, 1796-1848' - ignore. His sister Gaetana Petriello married Giuseppantonio Lucadamo in 1855. The marriage of Pietro and Grazia was not found: Guardia marriage indexes for 1855-61, 1863, 1865 (part) and 1866-68 were checked; 1862 and 1864 registers are not on Antenati. Grazia was born c.1845, so the marriage was probably c.1863-68 (1862, 1864 or a missed page of 1865).
